The disposition said DELETE on the belief the tier was dead. It is not: ColdGenerationPlanner is constructed twice in automation/api.py and the HOT/WARM/COLD ladder is tested. `PatternSource` is an optional seam that defaults to None — without it the planner simply plans without similar-pattern retrieval, which is defined behaviour rather than a failure. Not absent — explicit. components.owner_facing_projection: VAN stops costing battery when the phone is in a pocket

components.rationale: P3-AND-002. /v1/events was called once with a hardcoded zero cursor that was never persisted and never polled again.
components.owner_facing_projection: the activity feed keeps up, and says when it cannot reach the gateway

components.rationale: P1-VIS-002. The evidence renderer was unbuildable wherever the Android Gradle Plugin could not be fetched, which is how the committed evidence came to be two authority revisions stale unnoticed.
components.owner_facing_projection: not owner-facing; it is what keeps the visual evidence current

components.rationale: P4-VIS-004. Computed every frame, consumed by nothing: the only production caller renders a bitmap, which has no separable head, and the Canvas character already carries its own head motion in VanScene.
P0-EXEC-002. A dispatched command had no deadline and nothing polled the run id, so a Hermes that never called back left the mission at RUNNING forever while the owner read 'working on it'.
components.producer: CommandMissionLink.running sets deadline_ms; OpsScheduler missions.expire_overdue job
components.owner_facing_projection: NEVER_HEARD_BACK — 'VAN handed this over and never heard back', in the attention queue

components.rationale: P0-EXEC-002. GET /v1/commands/{id} was a 404 for every command, so the terminal owner-visible status was 'accepted' forever and the device had nothing to read a completion from.
components.owner_facing_projection: the owner status and its sentence for any command they sent

components.rationale: P1-GOOG-002. The check required the sealed parameters to be a subset of the submitted ones, so notebook_id was unconstrained and the agent runtime chose which notebook the owner's note landed in.
components.owner_facing_projection: a refusal naming the unsealed parameter, instead of a note in a notebook they did not pick

components.rationale: P3-AND-003. attention() and briefing() were declared on the client and called by nothing: the gateway maintained both and no app surface read either.
components.producer: CommandCentreActivity OverviewModule, from GET /v1/attention and GET /v1/briefing
components.owner_facing_projection: what is waiting for them, and an explicit 'VAN could not look' when it could not

components.rationale: P2-BROW-001. SubagentWorker was a Protocol with no implementation and create_app passed worker=None, so the assignments route answered 503 and task evidence was whatever the caller handed in.
components.producer: BrowserApi assignments route, bound per task
components.owner_facing_projection: browser task outcomes that report what the page did

components.rationale: P1-BROW-002. assess_injection could only reach SUSPECTED while the only stop was on CONFIRMED, so containment could observe an attack and never interrupt one.
components.consumer: BrowserSubagentRunner injection stop; browser evidence records
components.owner_facing_projection: a browser task that stops on a hostile page, with INJECTION_REFUSED as its reason

components.component: Wake model asset policy and loader
components.rationale: P1-VOICE-001. WakePipeline was never constructed, so 'Hey Van' did nothing and KWS_NOT_READY was unreachable because no coordinator existed either.
components.owner_facing_projection: 'I cannot listen for my name yet — no wake word model is installed', in the degraded list

components.rationale: P2-SEC-010. Any voice reaching the microphone produced a transcript signed as an owner command; nothing established who spoke.
components.consumer: the gateway command path (action class) and the owner's conversation
components.owner_facing_projection: a spoken refusal, or a biometric approval prompt, instead of a consequential action on an unidentified voice

components.rationale: P1-VOICE-001. The only foreground service was typed specialUse, which on Android 14 loses microphone access while the app believes it has it.
components.owner_facing_projection: VAN does not hold the microphone when it cannot wake

components.rationale: P1-AND-002. Onboarding had no pairing step and advanced on startActivity, so an owner could grant nothing and be told they were set. The step is derived from observed grants; there is no counter to increment.
components.owner_facing_projection: First run, pairing first, and no 'you're set' over an unpaired phone

components.rationale: P2-UX-001. A4, BIOMETRIC_STRONG, HMAC, reason_code, status.name and 300 truncated characters of scope JSON were on screen. An internal name is either translated or not shown.
components.owner_facing_projection: Every status, refusal reason and scope, as a sentence

components.rationale: P3-AND-001. No retry, backoff or breaker anywhere in the client. A 409 is an answer, not a failure, and retrying it is how one command becomes two.
components.owner_facing_projection: A brief tunnel no longer looks like a broken assistant

components.rationale: P3-AND-004. Five subsystems were declared in defaultSubsystems() and written by nothing, so all five reported WORKING on a phone that had granted nothing.
components.owner_facing_projection: What is not working, named, on the home screen

components.rationale: P3-AND-005. All seven RestoreAction values were defined, carried through the contract, and rendered by nothing.
components.owner_facing_projection: A button that does the thing, or says it cannot

components.rationale: P3-AND-006. replayAsync() was called once, at app start. A command issued in a tunnel sat queued until the app was killed and reopened.
components.producer: ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback, gateway health poll, owner button
components.owner_facing_projection: The queue empties when the signal comes back

components.rationale: P3-AND-007. Everything lived in remember, so rotation or overnight process death dropped the owner on Home with their typed text gone.
components.owner_facing_projection: Where you were is where you come back to

components.rationale: P3-AND-008. Three inline darkColorScheme call sites, a deprecated Theme.Material parent and no values-night. The light scheme is not the dark one flipped: #00DAFF is 1.8:1 on white.
components.owner_facing_projection: VAN follows the owner's own light or dark setting, legibly

components.rationale: P3-AND-009 / Rev 3.0 s41. The drag and its geometry were inside a 1,096-line Service in a file that imports WindowManager, so neither the arithmetic nor the gesture sequence could be executed anywhere.
components.owner_facing_projection: VAN cannot be dragged somewhere the owner cannot reach it, and a cancelled drag does not close it on the next touch

components.rationale: P3-AND-010 / P3-AND-011. cap 2.0000000000000004%, raw ledger keys as labels, and an empty state telling the owner to run python -m vati lake.
components.consumer: TradingScreens, TradingComponents, TradeChartCanvas, TradeBook, overlay panels
components.owner_facing_projection: Money, percentages and limits in words and digits a person reads

components.rationale: P4-AND-012 / P4-AND-013. Text sized in raw pixels ignored the owner's font scale, and a chart with no pan, zoom or crosshair is a picture of a chart.
components.owner_facing_projection: The owner can look back at what happened before a trade, and read the axis

components.rationale: P3-AND-009 / Rev 3.0 s41. The overlay's Compose tree was inside the service, reading its mutable fields and calling its private methods, which is why no panel could be named or rendered by anything else.
components.owner_facing_projection: The floating assistant, in each of its six presentations

components.rationale: DSR/PBO semantics are consumed by certificate evaluation and capsule promotion; CI executes the negative/near-zero DSR counterexamples and policy-version checks.

components.rationale: MTF is wired into the live account-service candidate path and fails closed when a required constituent is absent; values remain non-actuating strategy evidence until a separately validated capsule revision adopts role-specific logic.

components.rationale: FeatureRegistry is an executable admission gate consumed by FeatureContractValidator; certificate-required definitions are not production-admitted merely because they are registered.

The canonical builder derives DSR/PBO/performance from raw observations and binds immutable data/evidence provenance. A real owner-only production join now consumes the certificate: the device/A4-gated gateway forwards to an agent-hidden private commander command, which verifies the certificate-bound owner authority, writes the authoritative CAPSULE_STATE event, and atomically projects the registry. Restart replay is hash-lineage aware.
components.consumer: CapsuleRegistry.promote via the owner-only strategy promotion workflow
components.production_caller: POST /v1/trading/strategies/promote -> StrategyPromotionGateway -> private commander capsule_promote -> CapsuleRegistry.promote
